fact: The WHO country office's report for 2024 states that support from WHO and other development partners produced health data with timeliness and completeness of 99.6%, and that in 2024 WHO gave technical and financial support to the quarterly coordination meetings of partners strengthening the SNIS, assessed the functionality of the SNIS and digitised the data collection tools of DHIS2.
title: Rapport annuel 2024
publisher: Organisation mondiale de la Santé, Bureau pays du Burundi
